protocol.specific: Implement descriptor-selected STRING array storage as nonmoving object pointer plus slot/generation, padded/aligned to unchanged Cell stride. Public logical references/cells stay complete. Construction/mutation validate full input identity before caching a pointer; generic runtime reads, GC tracing and VM checked projection share full slot/generation/kind/pointer association validation and return status before publication. Borrowed get/pop receive the owning heap in the version-matched internal ABI, avoiding view/header/heap-charge growth. Native direct projection retains exact rooted parent and no-safepoint obligations. No diagnostic conversion/GC guard remains. No source or portable-bytecode semantic change. Material V2 change: a separate JIT string emitter generates checked child projection and transactional binding/register publication in the machine segment. It retains every runtime decoder predicate and the original PC/fuel on failure, replacing the per-element C bridge call.
protocol.evidence: fd92bc8 rejected first general candidate: Native pair ratio .84718926 passes; ON .99673734 misses .97 minimum. Earlier 613b703 profiles contain 142/842 and151/842 JIT string bridge leaf samples. Source confirms a C call per string load and repeated binding publication. V2 must change that work materially, not repeat V1 timing.
protocol.early_gate: Original title pair, 3 warmups plus 11 rotating/alternating fresh-process pairs. Native pair geometric latency reduction >=10%, each Native row >=5%; ON pair geometric reduction >=3%, neither ON row median/P90 >5% slower. Targets (not minima): Native pair >=20%, ON pair >=10%. Failed minima reject the candidate before full validation/timing.
protocol.full_gate: All32 correctness and independent Native/ON/OFF paired timing with 3+11 observations. Native summed medians improve >=3%; ON and OFF sums may not regress >1%. Any per-row median or P90 regression >5% gets exactly one confirmation; a repeated same-metric excess rejects. Preserve all observations and prior rejected experiments; fresh unchanged five-way comparison required after acceptance.
protocol.validation: Focused descriptor/string-storage/get/set/push/pop/copy/reserve/truncate tests; exact16B charges and originalcapacityplanner; foreign/stale/wrongkind/null/mismatched pointers fail before read/mutation/publication, GC traces initialized prefix and fails without sweeping malformed edges, slot growth/reuse/retirement and alias replacement. Empty/NUL/Unicode strings and zeroing. All reachable deterministic allocation failures, both zero ledgers. Full ON/OFF CTest; all32 correctness and Native/VM differential. Focused ASan/UBSan and secondary x86_64 throughRosetta plus all32 correctness. FullTier1/LinuxLSan remainopen. Six gates before commitment. Native/ON/OFF full32 paired3+11, exactly one confirmation of any>5% rowmetric regression, fresh fiveway only after localacceptance. New focused native-versus-C projection oracle checks every rejected identity component, invalid pointer without dereference, output/binding atomicity, heap/view epochs and exact fuel exits. Existing all-index JIT code-memory/allocator coverage applies to new emission.
protocol.exclusions: Keep114 corpus hashes, sourcealgorithms, commands,args,outputs,64MiB, completepublicreference/Cell ABI, exactfuel/span/sideexits, allprevious evidence. JIT staysopt-in. No all32/Tier1 parity claim from local aggregate.
